messages:
Noah: Quick thread - I'm adding an FAQ subsection to the audit-export doc covering legal-hold + per-tenant identifier opt-ins (PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5060). Need legal/security wording.
Priya: Paste the proposed FAQ paragraph so I can review.
Noah: Draft: "If a tenant places records under legal hold, those events are retained regardless of standard retention. If the tenant also requests inclusion of original identifiers for an export, that export is allowed only if the legal-hold admin approves and the action is recorded in the tenant audit trail. Mapping exports that re-link pseudonyms to identifiers are restricted to tenant admins and require documented authorization."
Marco: Good; change "allowed only if" -> "allowed only with documented approval from the legal-hold admin". Add a parenthetical: "(SOC2: evidentiary controls)" and mention exports are encrypted.
Noah: Updated. Also adding a tiny curl + jq example that shows excluding identifiers by default and how to request them: \n```bash\ncurl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"tenant_id":"t_314","since":"2026-02-01","pseudonymize":true}' | jq -r '.csv'\n```
Ivy: For docs tests can we include a short regex assertion that exported CSV contains tenant IDs but not emails when pseudonymize=true? e.g. `assert re.search(r"t_314", output)` and `assert not re.search(email_regex, output)`
Priya: Also add explicit line: "Tenants may request inclusion of original identifiers; such requests must be authorized, recorded, and linked to an approval ticket." That helps auditors.
Noah: Adding that sentence. Also noting edge-case: if tenant requests mapping export while records are under legal hold, the mapping export requires an additional legal-hold admin approval step - added as bullet in FAQ.
Marco: Security nit: include a short sentence: "Mapping exports are time-limited downloads and cannot be re-created without re-authorization."
Noah: Done. Fixed a broken anchor for the export-playbook link (it pointed to audit-export-format previously). Included a redirect in the PR. Pushed and requested reviews.
deploy-bot: docs-deploy: preview for branch docs/audit-legalhold-faq - https://staging.redwood.ai/docs/audit-export (expires in 48h)
Ivy: I reviewed the preview. Wording looks good. Will approve after Priya signs off.
Priya: LGTM with minor punctuation tweak. Approving now.
